title: Clean-Span Relief: A Seller Performance Standing Points Entitlement
content:
Part of a seller's active points also comes off before any violation's point expiry period has passed, as clean-span relief. This is a Seller Performance Standing entitlement that Northloop books on the seller's standing record; the seller does not apply for it.

## When clean-span relief is owed

Clean-span relief is owed on the handling date to a seller placed at Below Standard Level, Developing Seller Level, Standard Level or Above Standard Level whose standing record is in good standing or at risk, carries active points above zero, and shows no policy violation recorded in the last three whole calendar months before the handling date.

Clean-span relief is owed once for each clean span: a record that already carries a points-expiry entry dated three or more whole calendar months after its most recent violation has received it.

For clean-span relief, whole calendar months are counted by calendar date back from the handling date: a date lies in the last N whole calendar months when fewer than N whole months have passed from it to the handling date.

| Condition | Must hold |
|---|---|
| Level the seller is placed at | Below Standard Level, Developing Seller Level, Standard Level or Above Standard Level |
| Status of the standing record | good standing or at risk |
| Active points | above zero |
| Policy violations recorded in the last three whole calendar months | none |
| A points-expiry entry dated three or more whole calendar months after the most recent violation | not already on the record |

**Hypothetical boundary.** With a handling date of 15 September, a violation recorded on 15 June lies outside the last three whole calendar months (three whole months have passed); a violation recorded on 16 June lies inside them.

## How the relief is booked

The relief is booked as one points-expiry entry against the active violation that still carries the most points, the oldest of them where two carry the same, and the entry carries that violation's type; where the relief exceeds that violation's remaining points, the rest is booked the same way against the next. A violation that has received clean-span relief keeps its remaining points on record until they expire or are reversed, and a violation already reversed or fully expired never receives relief.

## Booking tool: `grant_clean_span_relief_513362ca`

**Capability.** Books a clean-span relief on a seller's Seller Performance Standing record: the given number of violation points comes off the seller's active violation points, recorded as a points-expiry entry dated today against one policy violation. The active violation points shown on the standing record drop by exactly that number, and the entry appears in the seller's standing activity with today's date, the violation reference, its type and the points taken off.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, using the tool name `grant_clean_span_relief_513362ca`. One call books one entry against one violation.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `standing_id` | Identifier: the reference number of the seller's performance standing record, read from the standing record lookup. |
| `violation_ref` | Identifier: the policy violation reference number the relief entry is booked against, read from the seller's standing activity. |
| `violation_type` | Enum: the kind of policy violation the entry is booked against, copied from that violation's record; exactly one of `listing_policy`, `restricted_product`, `intellectual_property`, `inauthentic_complaint`, `product_authenticity`, `review_manipulation`. |
| `points` | Fixed format: the number of violation points taken off as relief, a positive whole number (integer points, no decimals). |

**Return.** A receipt with `entry_id` (reference of the new points-expiry entry), `standing_id`, `violation_ref`, `points` (points taken off), `active_points_before` and `active_points_after`. A returned `entry_id` means the relief is booked and the standing record already shows `active_points_after`.
